speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Penny..

speaker: penny
text: Oh, for god's sakes, I'm in the bathroom!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Shall I come back at a better time? Hello.

speaker: penny
text: Get in here! Hurry! Don't you dare knock. I slipped in the shower, and I think I dislocated my shoulder.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Not surprising. You have no safety mat or adhesive stickers to allow for purchase on a surface with a low coefficient of static friction.

speaker: penny
text: What?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Tubs are slippery.

speaker: penny
text: I know. I slipped.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I have a series of whimsical duck stickers on the bottom of my tub.

speaker: penny
text: Yeah, okay, whatever. Will you just turn the water off and help me up?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: They're holding umbrellas.

speaker: penny
text: What?

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: The ducks in my tub. They're whimsical because ducks have neither the need for, nor the ability to use umbrellas.

speaker: penny
text: Uh-huh.

speaker: penny
text: Oh, my god. I got to go to the emergency room.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well, assuming you're correct that your right humerus is no longer seated in the glenoid socket, I would certainly think so.

speaker: penny
text: Okay, can you drive me? Well, I can't drive!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I don't drive.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well, it seems we've reached an impasse. But I could call you a cab or an ambulance.

speaker: penny
text: Ow.

speaker: penny
text: No, no, no, I can't wait that long, you got to help me, please.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: All right. Let it never be said that Sheldon Lee Cooper ignored the pleas of a damsel in distress.

speaker: penny
text: No one's saying that. Let's go.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Well, it does seem rather ironic that for want of 99-cent adhesive ducks, we both might die in a fiery car crash.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: I wish Penny didn't have to work, she loves camping.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Yeah, that would have been great. You and Penny having sex in the tent while I sit out here and watch Howard hump a cactus.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Okay, the best I can tell, there are eight other campsites nearby. Mostly science nerds like us, but just over yon ridge are two not unattractive middle school teachers who reek of desperation.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Wow. Wonderful. How old are they?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Oh I don't know, 50, 55.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Oh, menopause, nature's birth control.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Come on, you guys can't be that hard up.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: I am.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Yeah, me, too.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Look, they gave me homemade cookies.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Of course, they did. That's what grandmothers do.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: So, what are we waiting for?

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Relax, I said we'd stop by a little later after they have their nap.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Good idea. They'll be refreshed.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Cookie?

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Yeah, thank you. Mmmm.

speaker: leonard_hofstadter
text: Mmmm, not bad.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Yeah, very tasty. Well, so tell me more about these teachers.

speaker: howard_wolowitz
text: Not much to tell. They had a VW Microbus and were wearing tie-dyed Grateful Dead shirts.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Huh.

speaker: raj_koothrappali
text: Mmm. Good cookies.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: I see no organizational system in here whatsoever. Which panties do you wear on Mondays?

speaker: penny
text: I don't need panties, I just need shorts and a shirt.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: My mother always told me one should wear clean underpants in case one is in an accident.

speaker: penny
text: One was already in an accident.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: That doesn't mean one won't be in another, especially if I'm driving.

speaker: penny
text: Clothes, Sheldon. I need clothes!

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Okay, here.

speaker: penny
text: Seriously? Those shorts with that top? No... No... Oh, that's cute.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: All right.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: We should have you checked for a concussion.

speaker: penny
text: Okay, now, you got to help me put these on. But don't look.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: All right.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Don't look?

speaker: penny
text: I don't want you to see me naked.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Oh. Well, that's understandable. You may be interested to know that a prohibition against looking is well established in heroic mythology. Uh, Lot and his wife, Perseus and Medusa, Orpheus and Eurydice. They always look. It never ends well.

speaker: penny
text: Yeah, great.

speaker: penny
text: Ok, now you gotta help me get my arm into the sleeve.

speaker: sheldon_cooper
text: Ok.
